Tooltip_RemoteDoorOpener: A handmade electronic remote. Right-click a garage door or fence gate and choose "Install Auto Door Opener" to pair it. Keep the remote in your inventory and press the key while seated in a vehicle to open or close your doors without getting out. One remote can pair with many doors.
IGUI_AutoDoor_NeedRemote: A remote control is required in your inventory
IGUI_AutoDoor_NoDoorInRange: No paired auto door in range
